{{Top}}
'''Kamino Space Control''', also referred to as '''Kamino Space Traffic Control''', was the communications grid that alerted the various stilt cities of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] of trouble. It monitored the skies and seas for incoming spacecraft or vehicles using high performance communication towers at the top of the [[City/Legends|cities]].
